member.name: T:SysWeaver.Compression.CompBrotliNativeNET
member.summary: A Brotli ("br") plug-in that calls the native brotli library shipped with the Brotli.NET package directly, through . Registered with priority 1, so it's preferred over the built-in (priority 0) once is called.
member.remarks: Uses brotli quality 1 / 4 / 11 for / / with a 2^22 byte window. A new native encoder / decoder state is created (and destroyed) per call, there is no one-shot api. Concatenated brotli streams are not supported (data after the first stream is ignored). Requires the Brolib native binaries for the current platform and architecture: the Brotli.NET package only ships win-x64, win-x86, linux-x64 (glibc), linux-x86 (glibc) and osx-x64 binaries (use ).

member.name: M:SysWeaver.Compression.CompBrotliNativeNET.Register
member.summary: Call once to register this compression type to the compression manager. Does nothing if the native library can't be loaded on this platform (see ), "br" then uses the built-in codec.

member.name: P:SysWeaver.Compression.CompBrotliNativeNET.IsSupported
member.summary: True if the native brotli library of the Brotli.NET package could be loaded on this platform / architecture. If false, every compress / decompress call throws (a ).

member.name: M:SysWeaver.Compression.CompBrotliNativeNET.InitLinuxLoader
member.summary: The Brotli.NET loader imports dlopen / dlsym / dlerror / dlclose from "libdl.so" on Linux (not using the .NET Core loader on .NET 5+), that file is only the development symlink (package libc6-dev), runtime systems have "libdl.so.2" (or dlopen in libc since glibc 2.34). Registered when this assembly is loaded, so before the Brotli.NET loader is used from here.

member.name: F:SysWeaver.Compression.CompBrotliNativeNET.LibDlNames
member.summary: glibc: "libdl.so.2" (still present after glibc 2.34 as a stub), then libc itself. If none loads the default probing is used (musl maps "libdl.so" to libc by itself).
